requiredScenarioMatrix: AI/provider source-rights denial and safe abstention

RELEASE-RENDERER-CHROME-WEBKIT.rationale: This frozen responsibility owns Chrome/WebKit renderer portability only. It owns no token, artifact-publication permission, credential, secret, role or provider-right boundary. Release publication/security permissions remain owned by the release workflow/tooling responsibilities; assigning them here would duplicate canonical release-security ownership.

PERSIST-FILE-FALLBACK.rationale: The existing registered native persistence regression owner now executes a nested CGO_ENABLED=0 package test in the Qualified DB-integration job, causing production build constraints to select file-fallback. It proves bootstrap-token invalidation, authenticated identity continuity, user-workspace separation, and absence of plaintext password/raw session tokens in the persisted fallback artifact without adding a parallel backend or new root owner.

PERSIST-SQLITE-MAC.rationale: The normal cgo persistence lane selects SQLite and already executes deterministic credential migration/no-plaintext and persisted workspace-isolation regressions. These are the canonical identity/workspace owners; no SQLite-specific authorization subsystem is introduced.

firstExecutableCensus.finding: Source review found one renderer-portability responsibility with no T6 security ownership and two persistence responsibilities whose canonical security evidence existed but was not fully bound/executed across both local backends. The renderer row is T6 NOT_APPLICABLE; persistence remains applicable and is remediated through canonical identity/workspace tests plus explicit no-cgo fallback execution.

completionCondition: Every effective T1 responsibility has a T6 expectation and explicit applicability result; every applicable security/role/rights-bearing responsibility has current executable positive authority/access evidence plus negative denial/redaction/boundary evidence; all declared gaps are closed; exact-head Fast and identical-head Qualified pass.
